steps.en: Start an isolated evaluation with persistent data and unwanted features disabled

steps.en: Serve the repository UI and Git endpoints
steps.zh: 提供仓库界面与 Git 入口

steps.en: Create a repository and commit your container-build YAML
steps.zh: 创建仓库，提交容器构建 YAML

steps.en: Register its file path and branch as a pipeline, then request a run
steps.zh: 登记流水线文件路径和分支，再请求运行

steps.en: Read the definition at the selected commit and schedule its stages
steps.zh: 按选定提交读取定义，调度构建阶段

steps.en: Run container steps and return build status and logs
steps.zh: 执行容器步骤，返回构建状态与日志

value.en: Repository revisions and container-build results live in one platform
value.zh: 仓库版本与容器构建结果放在同一平台
